FFmpeg audio extension for OwnTV

Java renderer/decoder: AndroidX Media3 1.11.1 adapted by OwnTV_Core, Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/ahXN00/OwnTV_Core/tree/core-1.0.66/player-core/src/main/java/tv/own/owntv/player/ffmpeg
Native bridge: libowntvffmpeg.so from tv.own.owntv:libmpv:2026.10.3, sharing mpv FFmpeg libraries.
Source/build: https://github.com/ahXN00/OwnTV_libmpv/tree/v2026.10.3
ABIs: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86_64. Only audio uses this ExoPlayer extension.
Previous Jellyfin libffmpegJNI.so binaries are no longer packaged.
Original Java copyright notices and Apache-2.0/GPL-3.0 texts are retained.
Verification: vendor/OwnTV_Core/tools/ffmpeg/verify_audio.py.
